body_md:
This page lists six Naples, FL plumbing companies with a named owner and a Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor license that was checked. Each license was Current and Active on the Florida DBPR licensee search. Service areas, hours, and stated services differ, so compare those details before you contact a company.

## How we picked

Listings were limited to plumbing companies with a named owner and a Certified Plumbing Contractor license checked on the Florida DBPR licensee search lookup page. License number, status, and expiration were taken from that lookup, and each license fact links to the DBPR results page for that number. Service area, hours, services, insurance wording, and ownership notes are included only as stated on the company site or in the source record. Contact details were checked on November 5, 2026.

## At a glance

- All six licenses were Current, Active, and expiring 08/31/2028: Donel & D Plumbing Inc (CFC1427320), Bock Plumbing, Inc. (CFC1432148), Hancock Plumbing, Inc. (CFC1428957), Strong Plumbing Solutions (CFC1429823), McGrath Plumbing, Drains & Water Heaters of Naples, LLC (CFC1432700), and Classic Diamond Plumbing, Inc. (CFC1428773).
- Service areas include Naples or Southwest Florida, and the city lists are not the same. Donel & D lists Naples, Marco Island, Bonita Springs, and surrounding Southwest Florida communities. Bock lists Southwest Florida. Hancock lists Naples, Marco, Bonita, Fort Myers, Collier County, and Southwest Florida. Strong lists Naples, Downtown Naples, Golden Gate City, Golden Gate Estates, Marco Island, Bonita Springs, Estero, Collier County, and Lee County. McGrath lists Naples, Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Estero, Marco Island, Sanibel, Fort Myers Beach, Captiva, and surrounding Collier County and Lee County communities. Classic Diamond lists unincorporated Collier County, Naples, Bonita Springs, Marco Island, and Lee County.
- Donel & D lists Mon–Sat 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM, with after-hours emergencies available. Hancock lists Mon–Fri 8:00 am – 4:00 pm, with Saturday and Sunday closed. McGrath states 24/7 emergency service on the company site.
- Named owners are Donel Destine, Nick Bock, Curtis Hancock, Brian Michael Strong, Dave McGrath, and Alvino Huerta. Bock and Strong are described on their company sites as family owned and operated. McGrath is described as family-owned, locally owned, and founded by Dave McGrath.

## Things to know before you go

Match the job to the services noted. Bock, Strong, and Classic Diamond note new construction. Donel & D, Strong, and McGrath note water heaters; Strong includes Navien tankless, and McGrath also notes drains. Classic Diamond notes repiping and sewer repair and camera services. Strong also notes outdoor kitchen plumbing. Hancock notes service, repair, and remodel plumbing. Donel & D notes residential and light commercial repair, including faucets, showers, toilets, and disposals.

Donel & D states an upfront quote before work on most standard jobs. Bock offers a free estimate. McGrath states free estimates on the company site. Classic Diamond was established in 2001, McGrath has been serving Southwest Florida since 2004, Donel & D has been in business since 2007, and Hancock lists 24+ years. Nick Bock’s stated experience is serving SWFL for over 25 years. As stated on the company sites, Donel & D is fully insured, and Classic Diamond is licensed, insured, and bonded with work guaranteed. Recheck the linked DBPR record before you hire.

## FAQ

### What does “license checked” mean here?

The license number, status, and expiration were read from the Florida DBPR licensee search lookup page. Each license was Current and Active, with an expiration date of 08/31/2028, and the listing links to that results page.

### Do these companies list the same service area?

No. Use the service area on that company’s listing. Naples or Southwest Florida is in every stated area, but the surrounding cities are not listed the same way on every entry.

### What should I compare before I get in touch?

Your city, the job, and the timing you need. Set those next to the service area, the services noted, and any hours, emergency note, quote, or estimate the listing includes.
